fixture_name: NE Edmonton Ring Road planning-stage RSA — Canada TAC planning (real sample, Alberta Transportation 2009)
subject: judge-baseline

justifications.substance: A real process non-conformity with direct safety stakes: flagged local-access-in-system-interchange conflicts (speed differential, expectation violation) sit undispositioned in the finalised planning record, so closing the loop is substantive for this scheme stage.
justifications.evidence_grounding: The pivotal response-report duty is supported by the verbatim EV-CA-038 quote listing accept / conditionally-accept-with-modifications / reject options, with EV-CA-006 fixing the Planning=Stage 1 mapping and EV-CA-003 the documentation duty, all anchored to recorded package facts.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Correctly framed as a compliance_question under the Alberta instrument with TAC/Alberta terminology mapped via EV-CA-006; the underlying speed-differential safety concern is kept as background while the finding targets the categorical documentation obligation.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Specific and actionable — issue the §5.6.2 response report dispositioning each raised issue with accept/conditional/reject reasons and file it with Alberta Transportation alongside the functional plan — though the §4.1–4.2 section reference rests on package structure rather than quoted evidence.
justifications.vru_coverage: VRUs are not applicable on the access-controlled mainline but the finding explicitly acknowledges them, noting the flagged connections route traffic toward the local cross-road network where pedestrians and cyclists travel without asserting unsupported planning-stage exposure.
